segments.comment: Variation of queued-notice-status-kill-on-fountain with MSGTYPE=hide for the fountain notice. A debug-mode human Valkyrie maps the level with ^F so that walking raises no notices. She creates a hostile jackal, wishes a fountain onto her own square and steps away from the jackal, which follows onto the fountain; she names it with a 57-character name and slays it with #wizkill. wizcmds.c wiz_kill() prints "You kill <name>!", which nearly fills the top line, and calls mon.c xkilled(): mondead()'s m_detach() redraws the square, xkilled()'s own newsym() (3642) draws the fountain again while its gbuf entry is still new, and display.c show_glyph() (2011-2068) announces "(southeast): fountain." through pline_xy(). pline.c vpline() (245-264) drops the hidden line before it reaches flush_screen(), so the status is not drawn there: the --More-- comes from "Next monster:", after more_experienced(), and shows Xp:1/1.
